provenance.note: Ranipet district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope ranipet-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-ranipet). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: Ranipet SIPCOT CEPI area, core zone: frame through the plan's four reference points
properties.whatThisIs: A polygon through the 4 boundary reference points the plan prints. It encloses 1.8 sq km; the plan gives 3.4 sq km, so the true boundary reaches beyond this frame.
properties.latestScore: 21.792 on TNPCB's post-monsoon 2025 evaluation (TNPCB score sheet, signed 23 June 2026); 21.8 in TNPCB's 2026-27 policy note (p.94)
properties.cepiScore: 79.38 (Air 49.0, Water 75.0, Groundwater 35.75), CPCB's March 2018 assessment as the plan prints it: a Critically Polluted Area (plan, pp.4-5, 11-13)
properties.earlierScore: 81.79 in CPCB's 2009 assessment, as 'Vellore (North Arcot)' (Comprehensive Environmental Assessment of Industrial Clusters, p.26)
properties.unitsInThePlan: 349 industries in the CPA, 130 red, 193 orange and 26 green, and 2 tannery CETPs serving 99 member tanneries (plan, p.10)
properties.moratorium: MoEFCC's moratorium on environmental clearance, imposed 13.01.2010, was to continue for Vellore till further orders (Office Memorandum of 20.05.2016, p.3)
properties.source: TNPCB, Evaluation of CEPI score and action plan for CEPI area of SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Ranipet, January 2020 (TNPCB and CPCB websites)
